dialog.speaker: npc:stranger
dialog.tr: Kural basit: kolu çevirmek yasak. Bilek serbest, dirsek tartışılır.
dialog.en: Simple rules: no spinning. Wrists are fine. Elbows are under review.

dialog.speaker: npc:stranger
dialog.tr: Kaybeden çayları alır. Ben üç haftadır çay almıyorum.
dialog.en: Loser buys the tea. I haven't bought tea in three weeks.

choices.en: Give up your turn and watch

kural.tr: On-sekiz kazandın. Rakibin çayları aldı, üç haftalık seri bitti.
kural.en: You won ten to eight. Your opponent bought the tea. The three-week streak is over.

coach.tr: Seri bitti. Çayı bu kez o aldı.
coach.en: Streak over. Someone else bought the tea.

kural.en: You lost ten to six. Tea was on you: thirty.

coach.en: The streak is now four weeks.

cevir.tr: Kolu çevirdin, gol oldu, gol iptal edildi. Masadan bir tur men edildin.
cevir.en: You spun the rod and scored. The goal was disallowed and you were benched for a round.

coach.en: A goal was scored. It was not counted.

izle.tr: Sıranı verdin. Dört maç izledin, kuralların hepsini öğrendin.
izle.en: You gave up your turn. Four games watched, every rule learned.

coach.en: Four games. The elbow question remains open.

slip.tr: İDDİA: Bilekle bu masa geçilmez. — M.
slip.en: WAGER: Wrists alone won't win this table. — M.

intent.setup: kantindeki langırt masasında kol çevirme yasağı
